auth.verifyHint: After sign-up we will email you a confirmation link. Open it to finish registration.
auth.verifyEmailSent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
auth.checkInboxBody: We sent a message to {{email}}. Check spam if you do not see it.
auth.configMissingBody: Create a .env file in the project root with (from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API):
auth.forgotPasswordHint: Enter the email you used to register. If an account exists, we will send a reset link (check spam too).
auth.forgotPasswordGoogleHint: If you usually sign in with Google, use “Continue with Google” above.
auth.forgotPasswordSent: If that email is registered, you will receive a message with a link to set a new password.
auth.resetPasswordInvalidBody: Request a new reset from the sign-in page, or sign in with Google if you use Google.
auth.errorEmptyPasswordReset: Enter and confirm your new password.

upload.hint: Select multiple photos; AI will parse them
upload.allFailed: Could not process receipts. Check images or try again.

errors.parseReceipt: Server response error ({{status}}). If you use the PWA “Add to Home Screen”, close the tab and clear site data, then retry.
errors.syncFailed: Could not load or save cloud data: {{message}}
errors.persistFailed: Could not sync to Supabase: {{message}} (Run supabase/migrations/001_user_app_data.sql in the SQL Editor, and ensure Vercel env matches your .env project.)

list.emptyHint: Upload receipts or add an expense manually

settings.title: Settings
settings.ratesHint: Each value is how many units of that currency equal 1 base currency. Your base currency row is locked at 1.
settings.fetchRatesOtherOnly: Custom base currency: enter rates in the grid below. Live fetch isn’t used (this is expected).
settings.ratesHintTrip: Rates for the current trip. Values are units of foreign currency per 1 base currency. The grid lists live-updatable currencies; add others manually.
settings.ratesManualOnlyHint: This trip’s base currency is custom or not supported for live rates — enter manually; live update is disabled.
settings.addManualHint: Enter a 3-letter ISO code (e.g. TWD). Manual rows are never overwritten by “Update rates”.
settings.addManualInvalid: Enter a valid 3-letter currency code (e.g. TWD).
settings.addManualDuplicate: Same as base currency — not needed.
settings.dataHint: Copy report: copies the current expense list as plain text. Export and full backup are JSON files.
settings.deletePersonHint: Whole expenses and line items assigned to this person will be reassigned to the person you select below.

editExpense.title: Edit expense
editExpense.taxHint: Line amounts should match the receipt. For tax-free, “refund” is negative (paid − subtotal).
editExpense.receiptExemptionHelp: If the receipt printed an exemption amount but lines already match paid, fill this for display only; it does not change settlement.
editExpense.itemsHelp: Enter the amount per line as on the receipt. Check Fixed for fees/commission lines excluded from refund split.
editExpense.fixedTitle: No refund split on this line (e.g. commission)

expenseCard.duplicateHint: Same date, item count and amount
expenseCard.partialRefundHint: Proportional refund and net share below (matches receipt total)
expenseCard.needsReview: Line totals don’t match the sum; check bundle pricing or tax.
expenseCard.currencyMismatch: AI detected {{ai}}, which differs from this trip’s default {{trip}}. Amounts use the AI currency—please confirm.
expenseCard.receiptExemptionNote: Amount printed on the receipt. If lines are already net, this is informational only.

trip.title: Trips
trip.deleteMessage: Delete “{{name}}”? All expenses in this trip will be removed.
trip.cannotDeleteCurrent: Switch to another trip before deleting this one
trip.tripCurrencyHint: When AI cannot detect currency, receipts default to this (not the same as base currency).
trip.savedCustomTripCurrency: Saved custom codes (available in the dropdown)
trip.removeCustomTripCurrencyHint: Click × to remove from the list. If this code is still your trip currency, switch trip currency first.
trip.removeCustomTripCurrencyBlocked: Switch trip currency to a preset or another code before removing this one.
trip.accountingCurrencyHint: Reports and totals use this currency. For “Other”, enter a 3-letter ISO code; rates are manual only.
trip.savedCustomAccounting: Saved custom codes (available in the dropdown)
trip.removeCustomAccountingHint: Click × to remove from the list. If this code is still your base currency, switch base currency first.
trip.removeCustomAccountingBlocked: Switch base currency to a preset or another code before removing this one.

toast.fetchRatesFailed: Could not fetch live rates. Try again or enter manually.
toast.currencyNoLiveRate: {{code}} isn't covered by live rates. Cross-rates applied — enter exact rates manually if needed.
